title: Bookmark for Recipe Books
description: Add bookmark tab that you can save your recipe inside, make crafting, smelting more easily
body:
This is the mod that help you save the recipes you want to craft.

## How to use
1. Open your _Recipe book_
2. Hover your cursor on the recipe you want to save
3. Press the hotkey you set in the setting
4. Check your Bookmark tab, it gonna be there

_If you don't want to see the recipes you added, hover on it once more time and press the key you set, it will be removed from the bookmark tab._
